hero.title: Care that has watched the town grow up.
hero.sub: Sixty-eight years on, Dev Nandini is still where Hapur comes when it matters — a 540-bed multi-specialty hospital with named consultants, published outcomes, and the steady hand that makes both possible.

featuredStory.title: How a teaching hospital learns to slow down.
featuredStory.dek: Dr. Anjali Kapoor has been Head of Cardiology since 2014. She still does morning rounds at 06:40, two registrars trailing behind her, and still pauses at every bed long enough to be told off by the ICU charge nurse. We followed her for 38 hours.
featuredStory.byline: By Rohan Khurana · Photography by Meher Sodhi · 14 min read

college.title: Where the bedside is the syllabus.
college.body: 150 MBBS seats. 84 PG seats across 21 specialties. 1:8 faculty-to-student ratio. Teaching rounds, problem-based clinics, and a longitudinal ethics thread that runs from Year 1 to internship.

quote.text: They didn't just put a stent in my husband. They sat with me at 3 a.m. and explained, twice, in the language I think in.
quote.attribution: Saroj Devi · Garhmukteshwar · cardiac patient's spouse · 2025
